blocks.title: How To Guide
blocks.subtitle: A step-by-step guide to setting up the masters and running the asset lifecycle in Fixed Asset Management. Work through the masters first, then use the transactions in lifecycle order.

blocks.text: Follow this sequence the first time you use the application. Each step relies on data created in the steps before it.

items.text: Masters: Asset Category, Branch, Location, Department, Employee.
Masters: Depreciation Rates for Companies Act and Income Tax.
Register each asset in the Asset Register and capitalize it.
Record Installation, then Warranty and AMC cover for the asset.
Day to day: Transfer assets, run Physical Verification, and record Disposals.
Period end: run Companies Act (monthly) and Income Tax (annual) depreciation.
Fields marked mandatory on a form must be filled before you can save.
Most masters have a Status (Active / Inactive). Only Active records can be used on new entries.
Approval transactions move through Draft, Submit for Approval and Approve; Cancel is available from the same record.

blocks.text: Masters are the reference data used by every transaction. Set them up once, in the order below.
Classifies assets and defaults their useful life, depreciation method and Income Tax block.

items.text: Open the master and add a new record.
Enter the mandatory Category Code (unique), Category Name, Asset Type and Status.
Optionally pick a Parent Category to build a hierarchy.
Set the defaults: Useful Life (Years), Default Method, Residual Value % and Income Tax Block Code.
Save. The defaults are picked up when you register assets of this category.

blocks.text: The organisation branches that hold assets.

items.text: Add a new record.
Enter the mandatory Branch Code (unique), Branch Name and Status.
Optionally enter Address, City and State.
Save.

blocks.text: Physical locations within a branch, for example a floor or a store room.

items.text: Add a new record and choose the Branch Code (created in step 2).
Enter the mandatory Location Code, Location Name and Status.
Optionally add an Address / Description.
Save. Use Activate / Deactivate later to retire a location.

blocks.text: Departments or cost centres within a branch.

items.text: Add a new record and choose the Branch Code.
Enter the mandatory Department Code, Department Name and Status.
Optionally enter the Cost Centre Code.
Save. Use Activate / Deactivate to change availability.

blocks.text: A lightweight directory of employees, used to assign custody of assets and to pick verifiers.

items.text: Add a new record.
Enter the mandatory Employee Code, Employee Name, Branch Code, Department Code and Status.
Optionally enter the Designation.
Save. Use Deactivate when an employee leaves.
Add a new record and enter the Category Code.
Enter the Useful Life (Years), Method and Residual Value %.
Enter the Effective From date.
Save.

blocks.text: Block-of-assets rates under the Income Tax Rules.

items.text: Add a new record and enter the Block Code and Block Description.
Enter the Rate % and the Effective From date.
For existing blocks, optionally enter Opening WDV (Block) and the Opening WDV As On Date.
Save. The Block Code must match the Income Tax Block Code used on the Asset Category.

blocks.text: Use these in lifecycle order, from registering an asset to depreciating and disposing of it.
The statutory record of every fixed asset.

items.text: Add a new asset and enter the Asset Code, Asset Name, Asset Type and Category Code.
Choose the Branch Code and Location Code; optionally the Department and Assigned Employee.
Enter the Purchase Date, Purchase Cost and Capitalization Date. Total Capitalized Cost includes any Other Capitalized Cost.
Review the Companies Act and Income Tax fields defaulted from the category, adjust if needed, and set the Status.
Save. Only Draft assets can be deleted.

blocks.text: Records commissioning. A confirmed installation date also drives when depreciation starts.

items.text: Add a new record and choose the Asset Code.
Enter the Installation Date, Installed By and Installation Location Confirmed.
Attach the Installation Certificate and add Remarks if needed.
Use Submit for Approval, then Approve to move the status from Pending to Confirmed (Cancel is also available). Only Pending records can be edited.

blocks.text: Moves an asset between branch, location, department or employee.

items.text: Add a new transfer: enter the Transfer No, Transfer Date and Asset Code. The From details show where the asset is now.
Choose the To Branch and To Location (mandatory); optionally the To Department and To Employee.
Enter the Transfer Reason and save as Draft.
Use Submit for Approval, then Approve. Review the trail later in Asset Movement History.

blocks.text: Retires an asset by sale or scrap.

items.text: Add a new disposal: enter the Disposal No, Disposal Date and Asset Code.
Choose the Disposal Type (sale or scrap) and enter the mandatory Disposal Reason.
For a sale, enter the Sale Value and the Buyer / Scrap Vendor Code. Net book value and profit / loss on disposal are shown for review.
Save as Draft, then Submit for Approval and Approve. Only Draft disposals can be edited.

blocks.text: Plans a verification list and assigns it to an employee.

items.text: Add a new cycle: enter the Verification Cycle No, Verification Date and Branch Code.
Optionally narrow by Location, Asset Category and Not Verified Since (months).
Choose the Verifier Employee (mandatory).
Click Load Assets and tick the assets to include, then save. The cycle starts as Planned.
Use Submit for Approval and Approve when the cycle is complete (Cancel is also available).

blocks.text: The verifier records what was found for each asset on an assigned list.

items.text: Open the Planned or In Progress cycle assigned to you.
For each asset, set the physical status: Found, Not Found, Damaged or Extra - Unregistered.
Add Remarks and a photo. Assets cannot be added or removed here; the list is fixed when planned.
Save. The cycle then goes for approval from Physical Verification.

blocks.text: Manufacturer or vendor warranty cover for an asset.

items.text: Add a new record and choose the Asset Code.
Enter the Warranty Provider (Vendor Code), Warranty Start Date and End Date.
Add the Warranty Terms and attach the warranty document.
Save. Track upcoming expiries in the Warranty / AMC Expiry view.

blocks.text: Annual Maintenance Contracts and their renewals.

items.text: Add a new contract: enter the AMC Contract No, AMC Vendor / Provider, Start Date, End Date and Contract Cost.
Add the assets covered by the contract.
Use Submit for Approval, then Approve; this marks the covered assets as under AMC.
Before it ends, use Renew to create the next contract (the previous contract is linked). Cancel is also available.

blocks.text: Computes pro-rata monthly Schedule II depreciation for capitalized assets.

items.text: Open the process and enter the Financial Year (the year the financial year starts), the Period Month and the Branch (ALL for every branch).
Run it to preview the depreciation per asset.
Check the amounts, then save the rows with status Approved to post the period.
A period that is already posted cannot be generated again.

blocks.text: Computes block-wise written-down-value depreciation for an assessment year.

items.text: Open the process and enter the Assessment Year, the Block Code (ALL for every block) and the Branch (ALL for every branch).
Run it to preview depreciation per block.
Check the amounts and save to post them.
Ensure the Income Tax rates and the category Block Codes are set up first.

blocks.title: Ready to get started?
blocks.subtitle: Begin with the Asset Category Master, or jump to the Asset Register.
